articles.title: ’No clear catalyst:’ BMO downgrades Adobe stock
articles.mainIdea: ’No clear catalyst:’ BMO downgrades Adobe stock
articles.summary: Investing.com: ’No clear catalyst:’ BMO downgrades Adobe stock. Investing.com -- BMO Capital Markets downgraded Adobe to Market Perform from Outperform, arguing that the stock lacks a clear catalyst despite an undemanding valuation. The broker also lowered its price target to $375 from $400, while leaving estimates unchanged. Related tickers mentioned: BMO.
